entries.subject: Radius adopted from the published record
entries.finding: Radius: Limb-darkened angular diameter 2.76 ± 0.06 mas from Aufdenberg et al. (2002), ApJ 570, 344: the NPOI uniform-disc diameter 2.40 ± 0.06 mas times a model limb-darkening correction of 1.15 for a star with a wind. At the Hipparcos distance this is the record’s radius. Adopted 89,370,157 km, 128.4608 solar radii at 695700 km per solar radius. No gravitational parameter is adopted. presentationUp: the display axis (celestial north at the star) is up; no spin axis is adopted. Placement: SIMBAD basic record for * alf Cyg (HIP 102098), ICRS J2000 position, reference 2007A&A...474..653V, retrieved 2026-09-21: https://simbad.cds.unistra.fr/simbad/sim-id?Ident=alf+Cyg; Inverse of the Hipparcos new-reduction parallax 2.31 ± 0.32 mas (van Leeuwen 2007) via SIMBAD.
